events.content:
Done. Verified across two requests: timestamps (`47.029Z` vs `47.083Z`) and samples (`0.3785` vs `0.5317`) regenerate per request, while the nav ships in the prerendered shell.

- `next.config.ts`: `cacheComponents: true`
- `components/request-metadata.tsx`: now async with `await connection()` so request id, time, and sample are request-scoped
- `app/layout.tsx`: `<RequestMetadata />` wrapped in `<Suspense>` — nav and page content stay in the static shell (build shows `/` as ◐ Partial Prerender)
- `npm run build` succeeds; no route opted out
